title: Two session-load runs at once share one sandbox clone, so the later one records only a git checkout error
goal: Two session-load runs started at once each get their own sandbox clone and record their own rows, so neither records a CalledProcessError from git checkout (seen 2026-10-27: a run beside two others recorded one row and run errors 1 with git checkout -q -- . exit 128, where a rerun alone gave 99 rows)

run: import subprocess,sys; c=[sys.executable,"-c","import sys; sys.path.insert(0,\"_tools\"); import bench_core; print(bench_core.scratch_dir())"]; a,b=(subprocess.run(c,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout for _ in (1,2)); sys.exit(0 if a!=b else 1)

notes: Premise: the bug's repro fails on the base (origin/main at the planning commit, 2026-11-09); precheck ran it through the landing's check runner. Sprint order: items that share one file are chained with depends_on.
